claim: A ritual place in Blood's maps (E6M6, and the Death Wish add-on's DWE3M6 and DWE1M4) is four things: something the room is arranged round, made of sectors (a stone-rimmed pool half a body high with candles ON its rim, a hexagonal dais, a drum in a moat); people arranged round it facing it; a victim and the thing it is for; and an answer when the player acts (walls fall, the earth shakes, phantoms come). It is seen from above before it is entered.
evidence: E6M6 s192 and s281 (the pool), DWE3M6 s840 (a mouth of stone teeth), DWE1M4 s642 (seated congregation)
use: Build the centre in sectors (bloodmap.arrangement), face the figures at it, wire an answer, and give a gallery over it.
